name: Face Detection
one_liner: Detects and pinpoints the presence and location of human faces in a camera's field of view.
what_it_does: Scans real-time video frames using deep-learning models to locate human faces, drawing visual bounding boxes and capturing facial crops regardless of facial angle or lighting.
distinction: Face Detection only determines THAT a human face exists and where it is located; it does NOT identify WHO the person is (which is Face Recognition).
use_case: Retail customer engagement, framing subjects, visitor snapshot logs, and entry portal monitoring.
video_title: AXIS Face Detector - Loss Prevention Demonstration

name: Face Recognition, where legally authorized
one_liner: Matches detected human faces against an authorized database of known individuals for access control or security alerts.
what_it_does: Extracts mathematical biometric feature vectors from facial captures and compares them against pre-enrolled authorized databases to establish identity matches.
distinction: Unlike Face Detection (which only locates faces), Face Recognition identifies the specific individual by matching against an enrolled database.
use_case: Touchless employee turnstile access, VIP client recognition, and authorized facility security.
compliance_note: Deployment is subject to strict legal, privacy, and regulatory compliance (e.g., GDPR, BIPA, statutory privacy laws). Requires explicit legal authority, consent where mandated, and robust data protection.
video_title: How to Set Up Facial Recognition on HikCentral Professional

name: Person Detection
one_liner: Identifies and isolates human figures in the video frame, distinguishing people from background objects.
what_it_does: Analyzes pixel patterns with neural networks trained on human silhouettes to accurately detect standing, walking, and running individuals across challenging scenes.
distinction: Focuses on identifying the full human body, whereas Vehicle Detection targets motor vehicles and Face Detection isolates facial close-ups.
use_case: Perimeter intrusion alerting, construction site safety monitoring, and after-hours intruder alerts.
video_title: Object in Area Scenario: Human Target Detection (AXIS Object Analytics)

name: Vehicle Detection
one_liner: Identifies motorized vehicles such as cars, trucks, motorcycles, and buses within the camera's view.
what_it_does: Recognizes vehicular geometric structures, wheels, and outlines in motion or parked, providing reliable detection across diverse lighting and angles.
distinction: Specialized for motor vehicle detection, differentiating motorized transport from pedestrians, animals, or general background motion.
use_case: Parking lot occupancy, automated barrier gates, loading bay oversight, and traffic flow monitoring.
video_title: AXIS Object Analytics - Edge AI Vehicle & Object Detection

name: Human/Vehicle Classification
one_liner: Differentiates whether a detected moving object is a person or a vehicle, filtering out false alarms caused by animals, weather, and foliage.
what_it_does: Classifies moving targets specifically into 'human' or 'vehicle' categories, eliminating false alerts triggered by swaying branches, rain, shadows, or wildlife.
distinction: Applies real-time semantic labeling to separate humans and vehicles simultaneously, drastically improving signal-to-noise ratio over raw motion detection.
use_case: Outdoor perimeter fences, critical infrastructure borders, and automated surveillance dispatch.
video_title: Dahua WizSense AI CCTV Explained: How AI Cameras Classify People & Vehicles

name: Line Crossing
one_liner: Generates an instant alert when a person or vehicle crosses a predefined virtual tripwire line in a specified direction.
what_it_does: Monitors user-configured 2D virtual tripwire vectors across entryways, fence lines, or corridors, triggering alarms when a classified target traverses the line.
distinction: Monitors boundary passage along a 1D vector line; unlike Intrusion Detection, it does not evaluate dwell time inside an enclosed area.
use_case: Property boundary fences, railway platform safety lines, and warehouse loading bay borders.
video_title: AXIS Object Analytics - Virtual Line Crossing Detection

name: Intrusion Detection
one_liner: Triggers an alarm when an unauthorized subject enters and remains inside a designated virtual zone for a set threshold.
what_it_does: Enforces security boundaries across multi-point polygonal zones, alerting operators when a person or vehicle enters the zone and stays beyond a configurable dwell time.
distinction: Intrusion Detection evaluates entry and dwell time inside a 2D polygonal area, unlike Line Crossing which triggers instantly upon crossing a line.
use_case: Securing outdoor storage yards, electrical substation enclosures, and corporate premises after hours.
video_title: Configuration & Demonstration: AXIS Motion Guard Intrusion Detection

name: Restricted Area Detection
one_liner: Immediately alerts the instant any person or vehicle enters a strictly forbidden, high-security zone.
what_it_does: Maintains zero-tolerance no-entry zones around hazardous, high-voltage, or classified assets, initiating immediate lockdown alerts without delay.
distinction: Restricted Area Detection fires immediately upon the slightest boundary breach (zero dwell time tolerance), unlike Intrusion Detection which often uses configurable dwell buffers.
use_case: Airport tarmac runways, pharmaceutical cleanrooms, high-voltage electrical enclosures, and bank vaults.
video_title: AI Real-Time Alerts for Restricted No-Entry Zone Violations

name: Loitering Detection
one_liner: Detects when an individual or vehicle lingers or remains stationary in a defined area longer than the permitted time limit.
what_it_does: Tracks spatial dwell timers for targets within sensitive areas, triggering an alert only when someone remains in the zone beyond a specified time (e.g., >60 seconds).
distinction: Trigger is based strictly on dwell duration rather than mere entry; subjects passing straight through without lingering will not trigger an alarm.
use_case: ATM vestibules, jewelry storefronts, school perimeter perimeters, and unattended transit platforms.
video_title: Detecting Dwell Time & Loitering Using AXIS Object Analytics

name: Crowd Detection
one_liner: Identifies when a group of people gathers in a specific area exceeding normal group size or threshold.
what_it_does: Analyzes spatial groupings of individuals in real time, alerting control rooms when an abnormal accumulation or sudden gathering of people forms in a monitored zone.
distinction: Crowd Detection flags discrete gathering events or sudden group formations, whereas Crowd Density Analysis continuously measures spatial percentage saturation across a floor.
use_case: Public plazas, concert venue bottlenecks, hospital emergency lobbies, and protest monitoring.
video_title: People Gathering & Abnormal Crowd Detection Demo

name: Crowd Density Analysis
one_liner: Measures and visualizes the percentage and density of spatial occupancy across an area to prevent dangerous overcrowding.
what_it_does: Calculates real-time density heatmaps and occupancy percentages (e.g., persons per square meter) across concourses, warning operators before crowd crushing occurs.
distinction: Measures continuous spatial saturation and heat gradients across an entire physical area, unlike Crowd Detection which flags discrete group clusters.
use_case: Metro subway platforms, airport concourses, stadium stairwells, and festival entry gates.
video_title: Visualizing & Managing Occupancy and Crowd Density with Video Analytics

name: People Counting
one_liner: Continuously counts the number of people entering, exiting, or passing through a defined entrance or passage.
what_it_does: Uses overhead or angled AI cameras to track bidirectional foot traffic across threshold lines, compiling accurate In, Out, and Total pedestrian tallies.
distinction: People Counting measures continuous traffic flow and cumulative footfall over time, whereas Occupancy Counting maintains the live net head count inside a space.
use_case: Retail store visitor conversion rates, public transit passenger volume auditing, and building facility planning.
video_title: AXIS People Counter - Operational Insight Beyond Footfall

name: Occupancy Counting
one_liner: Maintains a live, real-time count of total individuals currently inside a building or enclosed space to enforce capacity limits.
what_it_does: Dynamically aggregates entries and exits across all doors (Live Count = Total In − Total Out), driving digital signage and triggering alerts when nearing fire safety limits.
distinction: Tracks net concurrent occupants present inside an enclosed facility in real time, unlike People Counting which simply records cumulative transit events.
use_case: Fire safety code enforcement, supermarket capacity control, corporate cafeteria management, and venue safety.
video_title: Real-Time Occupancy Control Solution with AXIS Occupancy Estimator

name: Direction Detection
one_liner: Determines and monitors the travel vector of moving pedestrians or vehicles along designated paths.
what_it_does: Calculates speed and heading vectors for moving targets, verifying that motion adheres to permitted traffic patterns or designated pedestrian corridors.
distinction: Monitors general motion heading and directional distribution; differs from Wrong-Way Detection which functions specifically as an active violation alarm for illegal reverse travel.
use_case: Airport terminal transit corridors, warehouse forklift lanes, and highway traffic flow management.
video_title: Wisenet X Direction Detection Video Analytics Demonstration

name: Wrong-Way Movement Detection
one_liner: Generates an urgent warning when a vehicle or person travels in reverse or against the mandatory flow of traffic.
what_it_does: Enforces strict one-way travel rules on ramps, access lanes, and airport security exits, triggering immediate acoustic or strobe alarms upon reverse traversal.
distinction: An enforcement alarm designed specifically to prevent hazardous reverse travel in one-way corridors, unlike general Direction Detection which observes multi-directional flows.
use_case: Highway exit ramps (wrong-way driver alert), airport one-way security exit gates, and underground parking spirals.
video_title: Bosch Security - Video Analytics - Wrong-Way Movement Detection

name: Abandoned Object Detection
one_liner: Flags unattended stationary items, such as bags or boxes, left behind in public areas beyond a set time limit.
what_it_does: Detects when an object separates from a human owner and remains stationary in a monitored public space longer than a configured threshold (e.g., 60-120 seconds).
distinction: Detects NEW, unapproved stationary objects introduced into a scene; in contrast, Missing Object Detection monitors preexisting registered items that disappear.
use_case: Airport departure halls, train stations, mass transit terminals, and critical government infrastructure.
video_title: What is IVS? Abandoned Object Feature Demonstration

name: Missing Object Detection
one_liner: Alerts security operators immediately when a designated stationary asset or valuable object disappears from its location.
what_it_does: Maintains a visual reference profile of a stationary valuable item and raises an alarm when that asset is no longer detected within its defined boundary.
distinction: Monitors the absence or disappearance of an existing monitored asset; differs from Object Removal Detection which actively detects someone physically lifting the item.
use_case: Museum exhibits, retail high-value electronics display counters, warehouse inventory checkpoints, and emergency equipment stations.
video_title: Dahua IVS Missing Object Detection Live Demo

name: Object Removal Detection
one_liner: Detects the deliberate physical act of an individual lifting, taking, or removing a protected item from its resting place.
what_it_does: Combines human interaction tracking and object state analysis to trigger an alarm the instant a person picks up, dislodges, or removes a protected item from a shelf or pedestal.
distinction: Focuses on the active physical action of theft or lifting in progress, whereas Missing Object Detection alerts on the static state of the item being gone.
use_case: Art gallery protection, luxury retail theft prevention, high-value tool cribs, and pharmacy narcotics cabinets.
video_title: Bosch Security - Video Analytics - Removed Object Detection Demo

name: Scene Change Detection
one_liner: Detects sudden significant changes in the camera's visual background caused by physical rotation, repositioning, or environmental shifts.
what_it_does: Compares structural scene histograms and key visual landmarks, alerting operators if the camera has been physically twisted, knocked, or redirected away from its target scene.
distinction: Flags changes where the viewing angle or perspective shifts, unlike Camera Obstruction (where view is blocked) or Defocus (where view is blurry).
use_case: Surveillance system health audits, detecting unauthorized camera realignment, and PTZ preset drift detection.
video_title: What is IVS? Scene Change Detection Feature Demonstration

name: Camera Tampering Detection
one_liner: Alarms when an attacker attempts to vandalize or incapacitate a camera via spray painting, laser blinding, sudden redirection, or physical impact.
what_it_does: Detects malicious physical interventions including harsh camera strikes, spray paint coating, intentional blinding with high-power lights, and sudden harsh rotation.
distinction: An overarching alarm designed to detect malicious human sabotage attempts on the physical camera hardware.
use_case: Correctional facilities, public transit stations, bank exterior walls, and high-crime urban areas.
video_title: Alarm Activation When Detecting Camera Tampering (Perimeter Security)

name: Video Loss Detection
one_liner: Alerts security operators instantly when a camera signal drops, disconnects, or experiences complete transmission failure.
what_it_does: Monitors stream continuity and video decoder signals at the VMS or NVR level, sounding an immediate alert if the video feed drops due to cable disconnection, power loss, or network failure.
distinction: Alerts on the total absence or death of the incoming video stream, whereas Tampering, Defocus, and Obstruction occur while the video signal is still streaming.
use_case: Security Operations Centers (SOC), enterprise VMS health monitoring, and regulatory uptime auditing.
video_title: Automated PTZ Tour & Alarm Linkage Triggered on Video Loss

name: Defocus Detection
one_liner: Identifies when a camera's optical focus degrades or blurs, warning operators that image quality has been compromised.
what_it_does: Monitors high-frequency image edge sharpness across the visual field and fires a maintenance alert when edge sharpness falls below critical recognition thresholds.
distinction: Detects optical blurring and softness; the scene is still visible and illuminated, but out of focus, unlike Obstruction which blocks the visual field.
use_case: Automated maintenance ticketing, ANPR/LPR camera quality assurance, and long-range perimeter optical verification.
video_title: How to Set Up Defocus Detection on Hanwha Vision AI Cameras

name: Camera Obstruction Detection
one_liner: Detects when a camera's lens is covered, blocked, or obscured by foreign objects, bags, tape, or overgrown foliage.
what_it_does: Analyzes sudden loss of visual variation and persistent low-contrast uniform frames to detect foreign physical objects placed directly over or in front of the lens.
distinction: Detects physical blocking or masking directly over the front of the lens, whereas Tampering covers physical strikes/vandalism and Defocus covers optical blur.
use_case: Parking garages, building stairwells, ATM security cameras, and outdoor cameras prone to vegetation overgrowth.
video_title: CCTV Camera Tampering & Lens Obstruction Alert Demo

name: Perimeter Protection
one_liner: Establishes automated multi-layered virtual boundary security around property borders while filtering out environmental noise.
what_it_does: Integrates deep-learning human/vehicle classification with multi-rule tripwires and boundary zones along outer property borders, delivering 24/7 boundary security with near-zero false alarms.
distinction: A comprehensive enterprise perimeter solution combining classified targets, directional rules, and boundary fences rather than a single basic line crossing rule.
use_case: Solar energy farms, electrical substations, industrial manufacturing plants, military installations, and critical infrastructure.
video_title: AXIS Perimeter Defender PTZ Autotracking Demonstration

name: Fall Detection, where applicable
one_liner: Recognizes sudden changes in human posture indicative of a person collapsing or falling down, enabling immediate emergency assistance.
what_it_does: Tracks human skeletal pose keypoints and downward velocity vectors in real time, differentiating accidental falls from deliberate sitting or lying down, and raising emergency alarms.
distinction: Monitors rapid vertical body collapse and subsequent lack of motion on the floor, unlike loitering or intrusion which monitor horizontal zone presence.
compliance_note: Deployed in healthcare, assisted living, and lone-worker environments; subject to healthcare privacy guidelines and operational applicability.
use_case: Elderly assisted living facilities, hospital patient rooms, industrial lone-worker zones, and warehouse high-bay racking aisles.
video_title: Slip & Fall Detection AI Camera Demonstration

name: Fire/Smoke Detection, where supported
one_liner: Visually detects open flames and developing smoke plumes significantly faster than traditional spot detectors, especially in high-ceiling spaces.
what_it_does: Processes optical and thermal video streams using deep learning models that analyze flame flicker frequencies, spectral color distributions, and expanding smoke plume dynamics.
distinction: Detects fire and smoke optically at the source within seconds, unlike traditional smoke/heat sensors that require smoke to physically travel up to a ceiling sensor.
compliance_note: Serves as an early optical warning system where supported; intended to supplement rather than replace mandatory certified life-safety fire alarm systems.
use_case: Aircraft hangars, high-ceiling logistics warehouses, timber mills, waste recycling plants, and petrochemical refineries.
video_title: Hikvision Thermal Optical Camera for Rapid Early Fire Detection

name: Vehicle/person tracking
one_liner: Continuously follows and plots the real-time path of an individual or vehicle across camera fields of view or via motorized PTZ tracking.
what_it_does: Assigns and maintains persistent object IDs across sequential frames, automatically steering motorized PTZ cameras to keep targets centered and mapping suspect trajectories across cameras.
distinction: Unlike Person/Vehicle Detection (which identifies objects at an isolated instant), Tracking maintains persistent identity, trajectory, and spatial coordinates over time.
use_case: Automated PTZ tracking of perimeter intruders, forensic suspect journey reconstruction, and airport apron ground vehicle tracking.
video_title: How to Configure Smart Tracking on PTZ (Human & Vehicle Auto-Tracking)

name: Behaviour/event-based analytics where legally and technically appropriate
one_liner: Detects complex human actions and anomalous security incidents, such as fighting, running, distress gestures, or erratic movements.
what_it_does: Applies spatio-temporal deep-learning networks to recognize predefined anomalous human behaviors, such as physical fighting, aggressive shoving, running in secured areas, or distress waving.
distinction: Analyzes dynamic human interactions and complex bodily behaviors over time, moving beyond simple presence or object classification into intent and event understanding.
compliance_note: Deployed where legally and technically appropriate; requires rigorous operational safeguards, algorithmic governance, and privacy compliance.
use_case: Correctional facilities, public transit platforms, school corridors, entertainment venues, and bank branches.
video_title: Milesight AI Violence & Abnormal Behavior Detection Demo
